system.description:
Mutations in your DNA have caused you to develop unusual abilities.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.iJ4lw3vOpXIC2Mwp]{Agility}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.5GDEdsr0jrDmWApP]{Flight}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.DK1Dj4AZrwDMvF9G]{Strength}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.9oftF6dPbn9LtnEz]{Vitality}

• Select from Intellectual powers category

• Select from Psychic powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.NfgdVMPFx7lCk9bj]{Danger Sense}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.p2eTkXenlMbLCLcI]{Adaptive}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.55TzmNoDVBOjwdqO]{Area Assault}

Gain one of these Green abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.F5ZJ235EmR5MPfNs]{Growth}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.jYSVL4a34V7rB62R]{Rally}
Archetype

Roll d10, d8, d8 for archetype selection.
